title: The FDA-Approved Antidepressant That Made Users Want to Kill
hook: It was supposed to lift your mood—instead, it flipped a switch in your brain that screamed for violence.
why_this_can_go_viral: Everyone knows someone on antidepressants; the idea that a prescription could trigger homicidal urges is terrifyingly personal.

title: The Pharmaceutical CEO Who Buried a Cancer Cure to Sell Chemo
hook: He had the formula that could end chemotherapy forever. He locked it in a safe and sold the key to the highest bidder.
why_this_can_go_viral: The ultimate 'they don't want you to get well' narrative—taps into deep distrust of the medical industry and hope for a hidden cure.

title: The Hospital That Burned 400 Patients Alive for Insurance Money
hook: A fire broke out in the ICU. But the hospital's sprinklers—and the truth—had been turned off months before.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines a horrific disaster with cold corporate greed—outrage and morbid curiosity drive massive engagement.

title: The Toxic Baby Formula That Caused 1 in 10 Infants to Go Blind
hook: Newborns were fed a 'scientific breakthrough' that quietly dissolved their retinas from the inside.
why_this_can_go_viral: Targets the most vulnerable—infants—making it emotionally devastating and highly shareable among parents.

title: The Disease Cover-Up: How 'Migraines' Were Caused by a Chemical in Mattresses
hook: Millions of people suffer from crippling headaches. The culprit was literally under their heads every night.
why_this_can_go_viral: Extremely relatable (migraines affect 1 in 7) and reveals a hidden threat in an everyday object—drives urgent clicks.

title: The Doctor Who Removed 1,000 Healthy Appendixes for Cash
hook: He told patients their appendix was about to burst. The only thing bursting was his bank account.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visceral fear of unnecessary surgery—everyone who's had an appendectomy will question their own experience.

title: The Experiment That Forced 50 Orphans to Drink Radioactive Milk
hook: They were promised a free meal. Instead, they got a dose of radiation that would silently gnaw at their bones for decades.
why_this_can_go_viral: Exploits the ultimate taboo—harming innocent orphans with radiation—creating maximum moral outrage and shock.

title: The Toxic Nail Polish That Caused 1 in 20 Women to Lose Their Fingernails
hook: You thought you were getting a beauty treatment. The chemicals were eating your nails from the surface down.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visually disgusting and shocking—perfect for 'ick factor' shares, especially among women.

title: The Suppressed Cure: $1 Honey Bandage Healed 70% of Diabetic Ulcers
hook: A $1 jar of honey outperformed $1,000 medications. The FDA called it 'unapproved' and banned it from hospitals.
why_this_can_go_viral: The contrast between a penny cure and expensive medicine is universally infuriating—perfect for anti-establishment shares.

title: The Doctor Who Performed 200 Useless Surgeries to Get Bonuses
hook: He was the hospital's top surgeon. Every operation added thousands to his paycheck—and years of pain to his patients.
why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into the fear of being operated on unnecessarily—creates distrust and drives urgent clicks from anyone facing surgery.

title: The Experiment That Made 60 Men Infertile Without Their Consent
hook: They signed up for a 'vitamin study.' The real test was seeing how much radiation it took to permanently sterilize them.
why_this_can_go_viral: Attacks the core of masculinity and reproduction—outrage and horror guarantee shares across all demographics.

title: The Disease Cover-Up: How 'Dandruff' Was Caused by a Fungus in Shampoo
hook: Your scalp was flaking because the 'solution' was actually feeding the problem.
why_this_can_go_viral: Almost everyone has used dandruff shampoo—the irony that it causes the problem is highly shareable.

title: The Suppressed Cure: $3 Apple Cider Vinegar Reversed 60% of Acid Reflux
hook: The $500 antacid didn't work. But the $3 vinegar in your pantry fixed it in a week—and the study was pulled.
why_this_can_go_viral: Acid reflux affects billions—the idea that a penny cure works better than expensive drugs is universally appealing.

title: The Doctor Who Sold Patients' DNA to Create a 'Master Race' Bioweapon
hook: Your blood sample wasn't for routine testing. It was the blueprint for a plan to wipe out millions.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines personal data theft with eugenics horror—a deeply unsettling, unique angle that guarantees massive outrage shares.

title: The Experiment That Kept 30 Babies in Freezing Rooms to 'Test Survival'
hook: They were days old. Scientists wanted to know how long it took for their tiny bodies to give up.
why_this_can_go_viral: The most vulnerable subjects imaginable (newborns) in the cruelest possible scenario—pure, shareable horror that will dominate feeds.
